messages:
Maya Patel: quick idea: split routing into match -> score -> enforce. safer rollouts, smaller hotpaths, but more RPCs. thoughts?
Ravi Singh: agree on safety. define minimal wire between match and score. keep it tiny to avoid p99 regressions.
Liam O'Connor: match should return candidate route_ids + tiny attrs (region,tier,compat_flags). scorer pulls cost/telemetry. route_ids must be stable.
Evelyn Park: tenant overrides: sidecar cache with TTL + invalidation on write is best ops tradeoff.
Ravi Singh: alternate: edge includes signed override vector per session to avoid per-request DB calls. validation easy if versioned.
Maya Patel: scoring should be pure (no side effects) so we can run in-process for Dedicated. enforcement emits audit events async.
Liam O'Connor: consider compiling policy DSL to wasm for sandboxing. cache compiled modules to avoid cold starts.
Evelyn Park: fallback native scorer on wasm failure. explicit degrade behavior in proto.
Maya Patel: telemetry rule: deterministic enums only, and scorer must emit cost_estimate + latency_hint for fast admission control.
Ravi Singh: testing: property-based tests for scorer invariants + nightly replay of traces. scorer version pinning required.
Maya Patel: action items: draft proto for match/score/enforce (I'll own), design stable route id scheme, prototype DSL->wasm (Ravi/Liam), simulate nightly traces (Evelyn).
ops-bot: Deploybot: created epic "policy-decomposition" RD-7901 and assigned to Maya.
Maya Patel: aiming for a proto by Friday EOD. will post link here. :v:
